SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{userId} AND r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{userId} AND r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.overall_score >= 4 AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS goodCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.overall_score), 1) FROM trade_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{userId} AND r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS avgScore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'done' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS completedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS paidCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'done' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS completedCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS paidCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_refund rf ON rf.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND rf.status = 'refund_success' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS refundCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_dispute d JOIN trade_order od ON od.order_id = d.order_id WHERE d.seller_id = #{userId} AND d.judge_decision IN ('buyer','partial') AND d.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND od.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS disputeCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'unshipped' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS overdueCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.order_id) FROM ( SELECT o.order_id FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_refund rf ON rf.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND rf.status = 'refund_success' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION SELECT d.order_id FROM trade_dispute d JOIN trade_order od ON od.order_id = d.order_id WHERE d.seller_id = #{userId} AND d.judge_decision IN ('buyer','partial') AND d.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND od.tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION SELECT o.order_id FROM trade_order o WHERE o.seller_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'unshipped' AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) x) AS penalizedCount30d

SELECT r.reviewee_id AS sellerId, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, ROUND(SUM(r.overall_score >= 4) / COUNT(*), 2) AS goodRate FROM trade_review r WHERE r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.reviewee_id IN #{sid} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY r.reviewee_id
SELECT enable_nearby_recommend FROM user_privacy WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT city FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY address_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT allow_mobile_search AS allowMobileSearch, allow_feed_by_stranger AS allowFeedByStranger, enable_nearby_recommend AS enableNearbyRecommend FROM user_privacy WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_privacy (user_id, allow_mobile_search, allow_feed_by_stranger, enable_nearby_recommend) VALUES (#{userId}, COALESCE(#{allowMobileSearch}, 1), COALESCE(#{allowFeedByStranger}, 1), COALESCE(#{enableNearbyRecommend}, 1)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE allow_mobile_search = COALESCE(#{allowMobileSearch}, allow_mobile_search), allow_feed_by_stranger = COALESCE(#{allowFeedByStranger}, allow_feed_by_stranger), enable_nearby_recommend = COALESCE(#{enableNearbyRecommend}, enable_nearby_recommend)
